blocks.text: STA. BARBARA, Pangasinan — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) will implement dredging, deploy mobile pumps, and construct water detention basins to ease flooding in Dagupan City. These actions will be done together with local government units (LGUs). “The first thing we need to do is to dredge from the upstream of the Sinocalan River, since there are a lot of areas in the upstream of Dagupan City that are submerged in water for a long time,” DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon said in an interview on Thursday afternoon.
